captions.detailed: A BMX-style crankset consisting of a central bottom bracket shell, a wide spindle, two robust black crank arms oriented in opposite directions, a thick silver-grey steel chainring, and two black platform pedals. The spindle, crank arms, and chainring rotate together as a single continuous assembly about the central bottom bracket axis. Each platform pedal is mounted to the end of its respective crank arm and rotates continuously about its own spindle axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a BMX freestyle crankset assembly with a central bottom bracket spindle, a thick steel chainring, two black crank arms, and two platform pedals. The spindle and crank arms should rotate continuously relative to the bottom bracket shell, and each pedal should rotate continuously relative to its crank arm.
captions.factory: Construct a fixed bottom bracket shell using a cylinder. Create a rotating assembly (spindle, chainring, and crank arms) connected via a continuous joint. The chainring is modeled by creating a base disc and subtracting arrayed wedge/tooth profiles. Build the crank arms using unioned cylinders and boxes. Finally, attach two rectangular platform pedals to the crank arm ends using continuous joints to allow independent pedal rotation.
